name: @astra/desktop
description: Astra Code Windows desktop coding workspace.
author: Astra Code

scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.package:win: npm run build && node ../../scripts/verify-codex-runtime-artifact.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis --x64
scripts.package:win:unsigned: npm run build && node ../../scripts/verify-codex-runtime-artifact.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.unsigned.yml --win nsis --x64
